$description: Universal DS — token source of truth. DTCG-compliant. Consumed by Style Dictionary v4 to produce CSS variables, Tailwind preset, and TS objects. See architecture.md for human-readable model and palette.md for hex obvious justification. TIER-PREFIX CONVENTION (2026-05-27): top-level keys group by tier — `palette` / `spacing` / `radius` / `font` / `elevation` are PRIMITIVE-tier; `color` / `semanticSpacing` / `semanticRadius` / `typography` are SEMANTIC-tier; `button` / `input` / `card` are COMPONENT-tier. Style Dictionary build prefixes resolved variable names with `primitive/`, `semantic/`, `component/` accordingly when emitting Figma Variables and CSS (e.g. `--uds-primitive-palette-blue-600`, `--uds-semantic-color-background-primary-bold`, `--uds-component-button-background-primary-default`). Tier prefix is the FIRST signal a consumer sees — explicit by design, not optimization. Component tier is MANDATORY from day 1; isolation is a structural principle, not a population threshold. VISUAL HIERARCHY (0.3.0): `color.background.page` is the page-level off-white. `color.background.surface` is the elevated surface tone — sits one layer above `page`. TYPOGRAPHY ARCHITECTURE (2.0.0, 2026-05-27): `font` Tier 1 PRIMITIVE + `typography` Tier 2 SEMANTIC (Phase 5.7: 25 roles × 5 properties = 125 composites — added Caption/Strong, Label/Strong, Label/Medium-tight, Heading/Inline, Kbd/{S,M}, Avatar-Initials/{xs,sm,md,lg,xl} closing Phase 5.6 sync-gap; primitives extended with `font.size.3xs` (9), `font.size.avatar-xl` (22), `font.line-height.xs` (12), `font.line-height.loose` (40) to support Avatar-Initials sized-per-variant scale — names align with Figma-side primitives created Phase 4.11). SPACING + RADIUS 3-TIER (2.1.0, 2026-05-27 — Phase 2.1): `spacing` and `radius` Tier 1 PRIMITIVE (raw scales — spacing none/2xs..6xl, radius none/xs..2xl/full). NEW `semanticSpacing` Tier 2 holds 4 intent roles × 5 sizes = 20 + `none` (inset / stack / inline / section). NEW `semanticRadius` Tier 2 holds 3 intent roles ≈ 10 vars (control / surface / pill). Component-tier consumers re-bound from primitive to semantic: button padding/gap/radius, input padding-x/radius, card padding/radius, icon-button radius. Breaking rename — old top-level `space.scale.N` removed (use `spacing.{name}` direct or via `semanticSpacing.<role>.<size>`); old `radius.scale.N` removed (use `radius.{name}` or `semanticRadius.<role>.<size>`).

palette.$description: Tier 1 — Primitive colors. Not published as CSS vars directly. Used only in semantic aliases. See palette.md for full justification.

spacing.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE spacing scale (raw values). Phase 2.1 restructure: named scale (none/2xs..6xl) replaces Phase 0 numeric scale (scale.0..24). Maps 1:1 to Figma `Primitive: Spacing` collection (12 vars). Tier 2 semantic spacing roles live under `semanticSpacing.*` below. Consumers never reference primitives directly — always go through semantic.

semanticSpacing.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC spacing. 4 categories × 5 sizes = 20 vars + 1 `none`. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Spacing` collection. Categories: inset (paddings inside controls), stack (vertical gap between siblings), inline (horizontal gap between siblings), section (large layout gap between page sections). Each entry aliases a primitive. Consume from here, never from `spacing.*` primitives directly. Phase 2.1 (2026-05-27): added.

sm.$description: 32 — small layout gap (e.g. between sub-sections of one major section)

md.$description: 48 — default layout gap between page sections

radius.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE radius scale (raw values). Phase 2.1: named scale (none/xs..2xl/full) replaces Phase 0 numeric (scale.0..5+full). Maps 1:1 to Figma `Primitive: Radius` collection (8 vars). Tier 2 semantic radius roles live under `semanticRadius.*` below.

semanticRadius.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC radius. 3 categories ≈ 10 vars. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Radius` collection. Categories: control (small radii for buttons, inputs), surface (larger radii for cards, panels, dialogs), pill (fully rounded — badges, avatars). Consume from here, never from `radius.*` primitives directly. Phase 2.1 (2026-05-27): added.

pill.$description: 9999 — fully rounded (avatar, switch knob, pill badge)

font.$description: Tier 1 PRIMITIVE typography (font-family / weight / size / line-height / letter-spacing scales). Tier 2 semantic typography lives under `typography.*` below (12 roles aliased to these primitives). Phase 2.0 brought this in line with Figma reality — top-level keys here emit as `primitive/font-*` in Figma Variables + `--uds-font-*` in CSS.

sans.$description: Loadable family name (Figma + CSS first reference). CSS export adds fallback stack: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif.

mono.$description: Loadable family name. CSS export adds fallback stack: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace.

size.$description: Named scale (replaces numbered scale.1..10 from Phase 0). 13 steps: 3xs..6xl + avatar-xl. Matches Figma Primitive: Typography collection 1:1. Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) extensions catch up to Figma-side primitives created Phase 4.11: `3xs` (9 — Avatar-Initials xs floor); `avatar-xl` (22 — Avatar-Initials xl, off-scale midpoint between xl=20 and 2xl=24, name scoped to consumer per Figma side convention).

3xs.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials xs floor. Below 2xs=11; do NOT use for body/label text — semantic-only consumer is avatar-initials.xs. Matches Figma `primitive/font-size/3xs` (Phase 4.11).

avatar-xl.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials xl coupling. Off-scale midpoint between xl=20 and 2xl=24. Name scoped to consumer (`avatar-xl`, not generic `xl-plus`) per Figma-side convention created Phase 4.11. Avatar-Initials-specific; do NOT promote to general body/heading semantic.

line-height.$description: Pixel values (Figma stores LH in pixels per existing text-style format). Includes generic scale + heading-specific values aligned per role. Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) extensions: `xs` (12 — Avatar-Initials xs LH, below `none`=16); `loose` (40 — Avatar-Initials lg LH, fills 40px container for vertical centering).

xs.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials xs LH. Smaller than `none`=16; sized-per-variant decoration.

loose.$description: Phase 5.7 — Avatar-Initials lg LH. Equals lg Avatar container height (40 px) — vertically centers single-char initials in the circle.

typography.$description: Tier 2 SEMANTIC typography. Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30): 25 roles × 5 properties = 125 composite values, each property aliasing a Tier 1 primitive. Maps 1:1 to Figma `Semantic: Typography` collection. Phase 5.6 added `caption.m` + `caption.s`. Phase 5.7 closed the remaining 11 Figma-side-only text styles: `caption.strong` (Inter Semi Bold 12/16/0), `label.strong` (Inter Semi Bold 11/16/0), `label.medium-tight` (Inter Medium 12/16/0), `heading.inline` (Inter Medium 16/24/0), `kbd.m` (JBM Regular 14/20/0), `kbd.s` (JBM Regular 12/16/0), `avatar-initials.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}` (Inter Semi Bold, sized-per-Avatar-variant). Consume these — never primitives directly. UNBLOCKS frontend-dev rebinding of: Card title → caption.strong; Badge label → label.medium-tight; Input label sm → label.medium-tight; Input label lg → heading.inline; Input helper → caption.m; MenuItem label → caption.m; MenuItem kbd → kbd.{m,s}; Avatar initials → avatar-initials.{size}. AVATAR-INITIALS NOTE: 5 separate semantic roles (one per Avatar size variant) because font-size + line-height couple to Avatar dimension — Avatar sm uses sm, Avatar lg uses lg, etc. Avatar consumer chooses size based on Avatar variant prop. KBD NOTE: JetBrains Mono primitive (`font.family.mono`) — Kbd/{S,M} are the first semantic roles consuming mono family.

inline.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Medium 16/24/0. Inline heading variant for use within flowing content (e.g. Input lg label). Lower weight than H6 (medium 500 vs semibold 600) so it sits well next to body text without dominating.

strong.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Semi Bold 11/16/0. Strong-emphasis label at 11 px (Badge sm label heavy variant, status indicator). Distinct from Label/S (medium weight): bumps weight 500 → 600 for emphasis context. LS 0 — semibold at 11 px reads without extra tracking.

medium-tight.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Medium 12/16/0. Tight LS variant of Label/M (which uses LS +0.25). Used for Badge label (all sizes uniform), Input sm label. Distinct from Label/M by letter-spacing only — tighter reading for compact chrome where LS 0.25 produces visible gap.

caption.$description: Phase 5.6 (2026-05-29). Regular-weight counterparts of Label/M + Label/S — secondary/descriptive 11–12 px text. Distinct semantic role from Label (which is for actionable labels, weight 500). Use cases: Tooltip sm description (caption.s); Card metadata, Input helper text, Tooltip footnote (caption.m). Maps 1:1 to Figma `Caption/Small` + `Caption/Medium`. Letter-spacing 0 (not 0.25/0.5 like Label) — Inter Regular at 11–12 px reads naturally without extra tracking. Phase 5.7 added `caption.strong` — Semi Bold 12 px Card title binding.

strong.$description: Phase 5.7 — Inter Semi Bold 12/16/0. Card title binding. Same size as Caption/M but Semi Bold (600) for prominent caption (vs Regular 400 for descriptive).

kbd.$description: Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) — JetBrains Mono keyboard shortcut hint family. 2 sizes: kbd.s (12/16) for compact contexts (Select kbd hint), kbd.m (14/20) for default (Menu / MenuItem kbd hint). LS 0 — mono renders cleanly without tracking. First semantic typography family to consume `font.family.mono` primitive.

avatar-initials.$description: Phase 5.7 (2026-05-30) — Inter Semi Bold initials sized-per-Avatar-variant. 5 separate semantic roles (xs / sm / md / lg / xl) — NOT a single role with prop because font-size + line-height couple to Avatar container dimension (LH equals container height for vertical centering of single-char initials). Consumer (Avatar React component) picks role based on `size` prop. Avatar dimensions: xs=20, sm=24, md=32, lg=40, xl=56 px. Sized-per-variant decoration class per client lesson 16 amendment (avatar-initials.xs requires font.line-height.xs=12 + font.size.3xs=9 primitives — both Phase 5.7-extended). Architectural note: lg LH=40 (= Avatar-lg dimension) and md/sm/xs/xl LHs equal or near container heights for consistent vertical centering. xl LH=32 is intentionally NOT 56 (would push initials baseline too low at this scale) — uses the same 32px LH as relaxed line-height.

shadow.$description: Tier 1 — PRIMITIVE shadow scale. 6 levels: none / xs / sm / md / lg / xl. Each value is a CSS box-shadow string. Phase 3.1 (Volna 2): expanded from pre-MVR `elevation.scale.0..5` numeric scale into named scale matching Spacing + Radius primitive conventions. Limitation: Figma Plugin API does not currently support EFFECT-typed variables — these shadow primitives are documented here for code-side consumers (Style Dictionary emits as CSS box-shadow), and Figma-side mirrored as native Effect Styles (`Primitive: Shadow / none..xl`) which serve the same role at the Figma side.

semanticShadow.$description: Tier 2 — SEMANTIC shadow roles. Phase 3.1 (Volna 2): introduced alongside Card component. Mirrors the 3-tier discipline applied to spacing / radius / color / typography uniformly across foundation categories (per universal lesson 'foundation 3-tier completeness'). Two role families: `elevation` for cards / surfaces in normal flow (resting state, sometimes hovered / floated), `overlay` for floating overlays (popovers, modals, tooltips, dropdowns). Figma-side mirrored as `Semantic: Shadow / {role} / {variant}` Effect Styles, each replicating the primitive's effect set (Figma cannot alias Effect Styles — replication is the only mechanism). Component-tier consumers reference these semantic roles by name (not by ID — effect styles bind by ID at the Figma side, by name in source).

sm.$description: Resting elevation for cards. Default for elevated Card.

md.$description: Hover-lifted card, dropdown menus, expanded panels.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips — small floating labels. Lower elevation than popovers.

modal.$description: Modal dialogs anchored to viewport center.

color.$description: Tier 2 — Semantic colors. Light theme values. Dark theme overrides in tokens.dark.json. ALL background tokens have paired text.on-* foreground (F-4).

page.$description: Page-level off-white. The bottom layer of the visual hierarchy. Used on root frame of every library page and on every product app page. Pair with `surface` for content containers — page = lower layer, surface = elevated layer above it. NEVER use page and surface on the same layer (no contrast). NEVER use page on a content card (looks like a transparent/missing frame). Renders as #F8FAFC in light / #020617 in dark.

surface.$description: Elevated content surface. One layer above `page`. Used on cards, sections, dialogs, dropdown menus, any content container that must read as a distinct surface. Always pair with subtle border for clean definition. Renders as #FFFFFF in light / #0F172A in dark.

raised.$description: Floating overlay surface — toasts, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns. One layer above `surface`. In light same hex as surface but with elevation shadow distinguishing it; in dark slate.800 (one step lighter than surface for chromatic lift).

transparent.$description: Named transparent background — semantic intent 'no visible surface, layout placeholder'. Consumed by component-tier tokens for ghost / danger-ghost / tertiary intents at default + focused + disabled + loading states. Distinguished from 'missing color' or 'unset' — explicit transparency communicates designer intent. Theme-invariant (same value in Light + Dark). Phase 6.0 (2026-05-30): added to replace hardcoded `#00000000` literals on 22 component-tier background variables in Figma.

ghost.hovered.$description: Hover overlay for transparent/ghost surfaces. Mirrors background.subtle but named explicitly to read clearly in ghost-intent component tokens.

bold.$description: Anchor at 700 not 600 — green.600 on white fails AA (3.4:1). green.700 = 4.9:1 AA.

focused.$description: Renamed from `focus` to `focused` for state-naming consistency (hovered/pressed/focused/disabled). Drives the 2px focus ring on interactive components. F-8 critical.

transparent.$description: Named transparent border — semantic intent 'no visible border, structural placeholder'. Consumed by component-tier border tokens for primary / danger / ghost / danger-ghost intents at default + hovered + pressed + disabled + loading states (where the variant intentionally has no border but the slot exists for symmetric variant structure). Distinguished from 'missing color' or 'unset' — explicit transparency communicates designer intent and preserves geometric symmetry across intents (e.g. Button primary and Button secondary occupy identical bbox; primary's transparent border reserves the 1px line that secondary fills). Theme-invariant (same value in Light + Dark). Phase 6.0 (2026-05-30): added to replace hardcoded `#00000000` literals on 29 component-tier border variables in Figma.

button.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Button. 5 intents × 3 sizes × 6 states. All bg/text/border bound to Semantic: Color. Phase 2.1: padding/gap consume Semantic: Spacing (inset/inline roles), radius consumes Semantic: Radius (control role) — was direct Primitive consumption pre-Phase 2.1. Loading state reuses default visual tokens; spinner is a separate Spinner primitive. Disabled state shares bg/text across intents. Focused state overlays 2px focus ring.

offset.$description: Box-shadow inset offset to give the ring breathing room without shifting layout.

tertiary.$description: Subtle filled — primary-toned background at low emphasis. Sits between secondary (outlined) and ghost (transparent).

input.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Input. Phase 2.1: padding-x consumes Semantic: Spacing (inset role), radius consumes Semantic: Radius (control role). Height + gap + icon-size + action-inset remain raw (control sizing — outside spacing scale).

card.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Card. Phase 3.1 (Volna 2): full token set built. Padding consumes Semantic: Spacing (inset role), radius consumes Semantic: Radius (surface role), shadow consumes Semantic: Shadow (elevation role).

elevated.$description: Elevated style shadow. Applied via Figma Effect Style `Semantic: Shadow / elevation / sm` at the Figma side.

badge.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Badge (Phase 3.1, Volna 2). Geometry as literals (off-scale control sizes per client lesson 7). Colors alias Semantic (style × intent combinations).

tooltip.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Tooltip (Phase 5.1, Volna 6). Geometry as literals (off-scale control sizes per client lesson 7). Colors alias Semantic. 13 tokens total.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding — less than horizontal for horizontal-emphasis shape

gap.$description: Stack gap between title and description

max-width.$description: Cap body width to enforce readable line length

size.$description: Arrow tip projection beyond body edge (pixels). Base 12 × depth 6 = 2:1 ratio.

offset.$description: Reserved for asymmetric arrow positions — unused in centered-arrow geometry.

bg.$description: Deep navy in Light mode — inverse surface for max contrast.

text.$description: White in Light mode — paired with bg for 7:1 contrast.

avatar.$description: Tier 3 — Component tokens for Avatar (Phase 3.1, Volna 2). Geometry as literals (off-scale control sizes per client lesson 7). Radius + colors alias Semantic.
